To give them teeth, add a served-cost overlay in mock_tools (PREFER a yelp_avg_cost_local / yelp_price_tier column on yelp_listings over the venues value) OR carry the lie as NL evidence in the b3 corpus. Only hours_* flaws are servable in v1 (search_yelp serves yelp_hours_* via its `hours` dict).
